description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery showing an urban and peri-urban landscape. The base image displays built-up areas and roads in shades of blue and grey, and vegetation in shades of red. Two distinct areas are delineated by cyan outlines, each labelled with a grey box containing the cyan text "1120". These polygons enclose large, rectilinear buildings and associated impervious surfaces, consistent with industrial or commercial units. Surrounding the classified areas, the map shows a dense network of residential buildings in shades of blue/grey and multiple vegetated plots and possibly recreational areas in red, indicating green spaces. A dark blue linear feature, likely a water course or canal, runs through the lower middle section of the image. The label "1120" corresponds to the CORINE Land Cover (CLC) class for "Industrial or commercial units". No scale bar, compass, or specific date is visible.
